interpretation: FCA outcome_probe / compensation / timeout_policy are semantic specifications; RDMS-04 *_spec / *_ref representations must resolve to semantically identical objects. Retry enum and verification mode remain unchanged.
acceptance_proof: Proof: dereference and compare probe, compensation and timeout semantics; missing/mismatched references fail closed. No conversion of IDEMPOTENT into exactly-once.
blocking_risk: Inability to reconstruct original outcome-probe/compensation and timeout contracts must block conversion.

interpretation: RDMS-04 action_kind is a broader tool category, whereas FCA kind includes file_write vs file_delete and shell. Keep requested_action_class distinct from ActionGate actual classification; preserve precise operation in execution_spec_ref.
acceptance_proof: Proof: inject file_write and file_delete under FILESYSTEM, shell under TERMINAL; round-trip must preserve legal effect kind, authority, preconditions and reversibility.
blocking_risk: Many-to-one kind mapping could conceal destructive operation; no automatic mapping until exact operation discriminator proven.

interpretation: FCA execution_result, observation_ids[], timestamps and compensation_action_id are not present as identical RDMS-04 fields; recover them through attempt/result/verification/observation references and legal sequence metadata.
acceptance_proof: Proof: replay ACTION with multiple attempts, partial effect, observations and compensation, then reconstruct every FCA recovery-critical fact.
blocking_risk: Single latest_attempt_ref is insufficient if attempt history is not separately durable and enumerable.

source_declarations: FCA v1.0.1:FCA v1.0.1 baseline:387,RDMS-02:Original draft:132,RDMS-02:Original draft:211
interpretation: RDMS-02 C01 replaces inline support certainty with separate SupportAssessment semantics; FCA evidence_for[], evidence_against[] and provenance[] cannot be dropped or converted into a VERIFIED scalar. Keep provenance and accepted EvidenceLinks independently accessible.
acceptance_proof: Proof: old claim with supporting and contradictory evidence projects into effective form and reconstructs history/assessment; no self-certified FACT or fabricated VERIFIED.
blocking_risk: Support is not a standalone truth claim; accepted correction precedence and evidence cardinality require proof.

interpretation: FCA level/basis/residual_uncertainty/assessed_at correspond to RDMS-03 scoped, versioned assessment and evidence_link_refs, with additional verification_record_refs. VERIFIED requires actual verification records and applicable scope.
acceptance_proof: Proof: resolve basis to accepted evidence links and proof records; distinguish historical assessment time from commit sequence and reject stale VERIFIED promotion.
blocking_risk: Commit sequence does not equal source wall-clock timestamp.

source_declarations: FCA v1.0.1:FCA v1.0.1 baseline:662,RDMS-03:Original draft:632,RDMS-03:C01 and Freeze Review 02 Final:2381
interpretation: FCA UNRESOLVED is a live epistemic condition, not RDMS-03 RESOLVED. C01 limits dimension_analysis to comparability and explanation_ref to separate causal entities. Keep unresolved/dismissed/resolved distinctions.
acceptance_proof: Proof: map candidate/confirmed/explained/unresolved scenarios without treating unresolved as resolved; late contradictory observations must preserve status and explanation provenance.
blocking_risk: No blind enum conversion for UNRESOLVED. Lifecycle meaning and derived unresolved predicate need legal ownership.

interpretation: RDMS-02 stores chosen_option_id, rejected_options and risk refs; FCA rejected[{option,reason}], evidence_refs[] and version must remain recoverable in canonical decision relations.
acceptance_proof: Proof: rejected option rationales, evidence, constraints, tradeoffs, accepted status and supersession all round-trip via defined refs.
blocking_risk: Flattening rejected[] to option IDs drops why rejected, violating cognitive decision memory.

source_declarations: FCA v1.0.1:FCA v1.0.1 baseline:2486,RDMS-01:Original draft:794,RDMS-06:Original draft:659
interpretation: RDMS-01 has a generic control dependency stamp; RDMS-06 supplies typed stamps, and FCA lists the admissible domains. Use RDMS-06 as semantic owner of freshness stamps; RDMS-01 references/projections must not become a second validator.
acceptance_proof: Proof: convert all nine FCA kinds, preserve exact/compatible/advisory requirements, version hashes and condition refs; fail closed on unknown kind.
blocking_risk: Shared name across three sources does not imply three legal owners.

source_declarations: FCA v1.0.1:FCA v1.0.1 baseline:616,RDMS-03:Original draft:461,RDMS-03:Original draft:514
interpretation: FCA observation_id singular versus RDMS-03 observation_refs[] plural. Multiple inputs must preserve individual provenance and cannot be naively duplicated into accepted independent EvidenceLinks. Empty refs are never accepted evidence merely because proposal schema permits it.
acceptance_proof: Proof: one-to-many evidence sources, cardinality, derivation kind, acceptance, target relation and atomic accepted commit; reject unsupported accepted link.
blocking_risk: A rejected or ungrounded proposal cannot become accepted supporting evidence through projection.

interpretation: RDMS-03 Experiment denotes immutable design while ExperimentRun owns execution; FCA Experiment includes RUNNING/COMPLETED/FAILED and observation_ids. Map FCA operational states to design plus run records, never simply to RDMS-03 lifecycle.
acceptance_proof: Proof: one experiment design, two runs with distinct results and observations; complete/failed/cancelled execution must remain queryable without changing design lifecycle.
blocking_risk: DESIGNED/AUTHORIZED/RETIRED are design lifecycle values, not equivalent to RUNNING/COMPLETED/FAILED.

interpretation: RDMS-02 refines FCA goal identity with explicit goal kind, typed priority, criteria and blockers while retaining status set. Preserve parent/child, acceptance, provenance and terminal reason.
acceptance_proof: Proof: complete goal status round-trip across all FCA states and preserve parent/priority/acceptance.
blocking_risk: Historical priority data without explicit class cannot be guessed; may require review.

interpretation: FCA symbolic mission/milestone/task/subgoal/current_operation fields become versioned RDMS-02 IDs/refs. Preserve optional slots, hierarchy intent and current operation reference.
acceptance_proof: Proof: serialize empty and fully populated stack, verify project identity and entity version and reconstruct ordered focus.
blocking_risk: Do not fabricate goal records for absent optional levels.

source_declarations: FCA v1.0.1:FCA v1.0.1 baseline:472,RDMS-02:Original draft:382,RDMS-02:C01, second review corrections and final freeze decision:2117
interpretation: RDMS-02 C01 separates support assessment from lifecycle and closes confirmed hypotheses with causal verification reference. Preserve evidence-for/against and prediction refs independently; ranking/support alone cannot imply causal verification.
acceptance_proof: Proof: historical hypothesis before/after C01, corroborated support without verification, and independently verified causal closure; preserve competing hypotheses and supersession.
blocking_risk: CAUSALLY_VERIFIED cannot arise from strong support alone; no duplicate OVC/causal claim owner.

interpretation: RDMS-02 adds scope, typed importance, resolution routes, resolution_ref and opened_from; FCA kinds map to RDMS-02 route set and open/investigating/resolved/obsolete lifecycle.
acceptance_proof: Proof: all route/importance/status cases, multiple blockers and cited resolution, preserving who/what supplied answer.
blocking_risk: If source resolution text lacks reference, migration must record provenance, not invent one.

interpretation: RDMS-02 replaces FCA singular enforcement with enforcement_modes[] and reference-based predicates/verification specs. Hard and critical severity may not be weakened to advisory or skipped.
acceptance_proof: Proof: hard invariant with multiple modes, scope, source authority, version and supersession survives; enforcement gates reject weaker projections.
blocking_risk: Multiple enforcement modes cannot be collapsed to one preferred mode without permission.

interpretation: RDMS-07 preserves FCA claim, source episodes, causal basis, applicability and counterexamples while adding versioned dependency/provenance/category references; promotion still governed by Learning Gate.
acceptance_proof: Proof: nested contraindications, evidence and confidence assessment resolve faithfully and no mere proposal becomes learned memory.
blocking_risk: Evidence and confidence refs must be valid; provenance absence cannot imply consent or promotion.

interpretation: RDMS-03 normalizes content and separates raw_artifact_ref/capture_integrity from source_ref and provenance. Preserve raw statement exactly and distinguish observed_at from ingestion order and time provenance.
acceptance_proof: Proof: late log with mismatched event/ingest times and degraded integrity; raw bytes still auditable and not silently promoted to verified reality.
blocking_risk: Capture integrity is not equivalent to truth of observed claim or source authority.

interpretation: RDMS-02 C01 separates causal lifecycle from derived freshness, and replaces FCA embedded causal-verification checklist with verification_ref. Preserve every required reproduction/prediction/intervention/regression/alternative-exclusion criterion.
acceptance_proof: Proof: load causal claim with full FCA verification matrix; stale then valid dependency change must not rewrite canonical causal history.
blocking_risk: If verification_ref cannot reconstruct checklist, causal claim cannot be promoted to OPERATIONALLY_VERIFIED.

interpretation: RDMS-06 aliases FCA query kind, query identifier and invalidation rule to typed references while preserving proof_scope, frontier, index generation, frontier hash and repository revision.
acceptance_proof: Proof: each query kind and generation/hash invalidation round-trip; missing proof scope fails conservative freshness check.
blocking_risk: Absence proof must not become universal merely because a narrow index returned no match.

interpretation: RDMS-04 enriches FCA activity summary with proof, sandbox and artifact refs; FCA result must be retained as a retrievable bounded outcome rather than implied from completed_at.
acceptance_proof: Proof: reconstruct number of operations, outputs, observations, containment proof, final snapshot and result including failure/partial.
blocking_risk: If containment proof is missing, sandbox fast-path forbidden regardless of recorded completion.

interpretation: RDMS-02 uses typed lifecycle and risk_refs while FCA has risk_profile, rollback and proof obligations. Preserve expected_change_surface including modules/contracts/state owners/APIs/persistent data.
acceptance_proof: Proof: reconcile actual versus expected change surface, proof obligations, rollback conditions, scope changes and all lifecycle statuses.
blocking_risk: Do not silently equate IMPLEMENTED with VERIFIED/INTEGRATED/CLOSED.

interpretation: RDMS-05 structurally mirrors FCA temporal validity and changes freshness enum capitalization; keep observed_at/verified_at/repo_ref/state_version/valid_until_condition.
acceptance_proof: Proof: CURRENT/STALE/UNKNOWN round-trip and nullability with version/predicate references.
blocking_risk: CURRENT must be recomputed when conditions expire; enum text change is not new proof of currentness.
